lessons.title: Shadow one travel phrase
lessons.objective: Echo one short French travel phrase with a selected consonant and rhythm target.
lessons.focus: Listen to Je prends le train demain matin as one message. Echo it after a reviewed model, attending first to the /ʁ/ in prends and train, then to the end of the full rhythmic group. Keep the departure meaning intact while comparing your recording with the model.

words.fr: Je prends le train demain matin.
words.en: I'm taking the train tomorrow morning.

words.fr: Le départ est prévu à la gare du Nord.
words.en: Departure is scheduled at the Gare du Nord.
Listen to the sentence, then repeat it.

words.fr: Je compare ma voix au modèle.
words.en: I compare my voice with the model.

reader.fr: Yasmine annonce à son ami qu'elle prendra le train demain matin.
reader.en: Yasmine tells her friend that she will take the train tomorrow morning.

reader.fr: Elle écoute d'abord la phrase enregistrée : « Je prends le train demain matin. »
reader.en: She first listens to the recorded sentence: 'I'm taking the train tomorrow morning.'

reader.fr: Elle répète la phrase après le modèle, puis écoute sa propre voix.
reader.en: She repeats the sentence after the model, then listens to her own voice.

reader.fr: Son ami confirme que le départ est prévu à la gare du Nord.
reader.en: Her friend confirms that departure is scheduled at the Gare du Nord.

grammar.focus: Je prends describes the speaker's planned travel; le départ est prévu gives the scheduled departure.

lessons.title: Shadow a short paragraph
lessons.objective: Carry French rhythmic groups across a four-sentence museum message without losing its meaning.
lessons.focus: Listen to the whole museum message for its day, entrance, and meeting point. Echo one sentence at a time, then join adjacent sentences while keeping their phrasing and details. Increase the chunk length only after the shorter recorded model is clear.

lessons.title: Read a new notice aloud
lessons.objective: Transfer French sound and rhythmic-group habits to a first-encounter library notice.
lessons.focus: Read the notice once for its meaning before hearing a model: La bibliothèque ferme à dix-huit heures. Les livres empruntés peuvent être rendus demain matin. Then read it aloud in complete groups. Check the /bl/ cluster in bibliothèque and the silent written endings only against a reviewed French model; this passage is not one of the earlier shadowing drills.

words.fr: La bibliothèque ferme à dix-huit heures.
words.en: The library closes at six o'clock in the evening.

words.fr: Les livres empruntés peuvent être rendus demain matin.
words.en: Borrowed books can be returned tomorrow morning.

words.fr: Je lis l'avis avant d'écouter le modèle.
words.en: I read the notice before listening to the model.

words.fr: Je vérifie l'heure et le jour de retour.
words.en: I check the time and the return day.

reader.en: Nadia reads the notice aloud, then checks the time with her friend.

grammar.focus: Peuvent être rendus uses a passive infinitive after peuvent to say that borrowed books may be returned.
